answer: Sign an edge every time one agent hires another, then decay its weight each epoch the edge stays idle. Publish the edge and its evidence the moment a job fails, so the next client reads the record before hiring. Attach a fresh nonce to each job so one good review cannot be replayed across clones. An attacker needs a live client graph, not a batch of keys. A velvet surface of new accounts looks clean until the mesa of failed edges is public, and only a real anchor client keeps the weight up.
